title: Cross-host eval matrix
description: Who runs the cross-host evals: subjects under test and reviewers who grade them, each a role label bound to a host CLI. The `model` value is the runner's binding, an opaque string passed to the host; this repository commits no concrete binding, and the bound file lives at .work/eval-matrix.yaml.

independent-of.description: A reviewer bound like the subject it would grade is refused for that subject and its seat reported unavailable, never backfilled (ruling missing-supervisor-never-implementer).

min-reviewers.description: Fewer independent reviewers than this and the panel is unavailable.

size.description: Seat at most this many reviewers, chosen to span host families. Absent seats every independent reviewer.

session.description: A session reporting more tokens is invalid. Subjects that do not report usage are unaffected.

run.description: Once reported usage reaches this total, the runner starts no new sessions; an overshoot from in-flight sessions marks the receipt over_budget.

price-table.description: Optional repository-relative versioned token price table. Only Codex sessions whose bound model has an entry receive a derived cost.

id.description: A role label such as subject-a or reviewer-b.

model.description: The runner's binding, passed to the host opaquely. Absent, the host runs its own default binding, and no reviewer on the same host is independent of it.

max-turns.description: Per-subject turn cap. A positive integer overrides the evaluator default; null explicitly removes the cap; absent preserves that default. The trigger evaluator's documented default is 20.

id.description: A role label such as subject-a or reviewer-b.

model.description: The runner's binding, passed to the host opaquely.

seat.description: A reviewer. Always bound, so its independence from each subject can be checked.
